title: S04T03 - Enforce descendant review and acceptance coverage on containers
description: Make sprint and milestone acceptance compute review, verification, checkpoint, force, and unresolved-finding coverage across their declared scopes.
acceptanceCriteria: Container acceptance reports exact uncovered descendants, stale approvals, open findings, forced gates, and clearing commands.
A parent cannot imply review or acceptance that its governed descendants did not receive.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
